s.g: The (cognitive, mental, or emotional) viewpoint of a certain person; (attributively) from that viewpoint.

(by extension) A discourse marker signalling "imagine, if you will, being in the situation that this text, photo, or video depicts", even in cases where third-person viewpoint exists; compare also fourth wall joke.
(physically) The vantage point of a particular person; (attributively) from that vantage point.
The quality or state of being poor; lack of money
A deficiency of something needed or desired
A powdered form of polyvinylpyrrolidone that is used as a dispersing and suspending agent in drugs.

s.x: She went to some povo school down the street.

s.g: (Australia, UK, slang, derogatory) One who is poor, a pauper.
s.x: This area is full of povos.
